title: 2D Yang-Mills Heat Kernel Techniques for 3D/4D Extension
description: Proves that 2D Yang-Mills heat kernel terms decay exponentially with area, Wilson loops satisfy an exact area law, and the SU(2) string tension is explicitly computable (sigma = 3g^2/16). The partition function decays monotonically from Z(0) = 14 to trivial representation dominance. These exact 2D results contrast with 3D (topological/Chern-Simons) and 4D (Millennium Prize) where no closed-form solutions exist.

meta.author: Migdal (1975), Witten (1991), Sengupta (1997)
meta.assumptions: None. Fully verified with 0 axioms, 0 sorries. All theorems (heat kernel positivity, decay, Wilson loop area law, SU(2) string tension, partition function bounds) are proved from definitions using Mathlib tactics.
